zh.title: Session Token：登入之後的權限憑證
zh.summary: 網站常以工作階段識別碼延續登入狀態。保護它的傳輸、儲存與失效流程，和保護密碼一樣需要明確設計。
objectives: 說明 Session Token 為何可能代表使用者權限。
區分 Secure、HttpOnly 與伺服端失效的角色。

sections.heading: 持有 Token 與重新輸入密碼不同
paragraphs: 登入後，伺服器可能把工作階段識別碼放進 Cookie。後續請求攜帶識別碼，伺服器依此查找身分與狀態。若系統把持有 Token 當成充分條件，取得有效 Token 的人可能不必重新輸入密碼就能使用該工作階段。
因此不要把真實 Token 放進公開截圖、網址或除錯紀錄。此單元只用虛構名稱描述生命週期，不展示或收集任何真實 Cookie。

sections.heading: 每個保護處理不同風險
paragraphs: Secure 限制 Cookie 在安全傳輸情境送出；HttpOnly 阻止一般頁面腳本透過 document.cookie 讀取它，但不能阻止所有 XSS 行為。SameSite 約束部分跨站送出情境，也不能取代所有請求授權與 CSRF 防護設計。
登入或權限變更後的識別碼更新、閒置與絕對期限、登出及撤銷都屬於生命週期。只刪除瀏覽器 Cookie，不能自動保證伺服端的舊識別碼已無效；需檢查舊 Token 是否仍被接受。

example.title: 例子：登出後舊識別碼仍有效
example.scenario: 合成流程是登入取得 S1、登出刪除瀏覽器 Cookie，但伺服器仍保存 S1 為有效。
example.reasoning: 瀏覽器不再自動送出 S1，與伺服器拒絕 S1 是不同狀態。若 S1 曾被複製，單靠刪除 Cookie 無法完成撤銷。
example.conclusion: 登出驗收應包含舊工作階段不再被接受。

lab.title: 紙上練習：畫出工作階段狀態
lab.environment: 用紙筆與虛構識別碼 S1、S2；不讀取真實 Cookie。
steps: 畫出未登入、S1 有效、登出、S1 失效四個狀態。
加入權限變更後換成 S2 的分支。
指出哪個步驟需要伺服端證據。
lab.expected: 舊識別碼失效需要伺服器拒絕的證據；UI 回到登入畫面不夠。
lab.check: HttpOnly 是否能保證被注入的腳本無法代使用者送出任何請求？
lab.cleanup: 保留狀態圖；沒有真實工作階段需要清除。

en.title: Session tokens: authority after login
en.summary: Websites often maintain login state with a session identifier. Its transport, storage and invalidation need deliberate protection alongside the password.
objectives: Explain why a session token can carry a user’s authority.
Distinguish Secure, HttpOnly and server-side invalidation.

sections.heading: Possession of a token differs from entering a password
paragraphs: After login, a server may place a session identifier in a cookie. Later requests carry it, allowing the server to recover identity and state. If possession is sufficient, someone holding a valid token may use that session without re-entering the password.
Do not place real tokens in public screenshots, URLs or debugging records. This unit uses fictional labels to describe the lifecycle and displays or collects no real cookies.

sections.heading: Each protection addresses a different risk
paragraphs: Secure restricts cookie transmission to secure contexts. HttpOnly prevents ordinary page scripts from reading it through document.cookie, but does not stop every XSS action. SameSite constrains some cross-site transmission and does not replace request authorization or a complete CSRF defense.

Identifier renewal after login or privilege changes, idle and absolute timeouts, logout and revocation belong to the lifecycle. Deleting a browser cookie does not automatically invalidate the old identifier on the server; verify that it is no longer accepted.

example.title: Example: an old identifier survives logout
example.scenario: A synthetic flow logs in with S1, then removes the browser cookie on logout while the server still considers S1 valid.
example.reasoning: The browser no longer sending S1 differs from the server rejecting S1. If S1 was copied, deleting the cookie alone does not revoke that copy.
example.conclusion: Logout acceptance should include rejection of the old session.

lab.title: Tabletop exercise: draw session states
lab.environment: Use paper and fictional identifiers S1 and S2. Do not read real cookies.
steps: Draw logged out, S1 active, logout requested and S1 invalid.
Add a branch renewing the identifier to S2 after a privilege change.
Mark the step that needs server-side evidence.
lab.expected: Invalidation needs evidence that the server rejects the old identifier; returning to a login screen is insufficient.
lab.check: Does HttpOnly guarantee that injected scripts cannot send any requests as the user?
lab.cleanup: Keep the state diagram. No real sessions need clearing.

zh.prompt: 登出畫面出現，就能證明舊 Token 已失效嗎？
options: 能，畫面就是伺服端證據
不能，還需確認伺服器拒絕舊 Token
不能，Token 永遠無法失效
rationales: UI 狀態不能代替伺服端驗證。
有效性由伺服端的驗證流程決定。
本機清除不會自動撤銷其他副本。
系統可以設計失效與撤銷。

en.prompt: Does seeing the logout screen prove the old token is invalid?
options: Yes; the screen is server-side proof
No; verify that the server rejects the old token
Yes, if the local cookie is cleared
rationales: UI state does not replace server-side verification.
Validity depends on the server’s verification process.
Local deletion does not automatically revoke other copies.
Systems can implement expiration and revocation.

options: 頁面腳本直接讀取該 Cookie
rationales: 這是 HttpOnly 的核心功能。
它不是完整的 XSS 防護。
跨站送出另涉及 SameSite 與 CSRF 控制。
伺服器仍需讀取 Cookie 處理工作階段。

options: Direct access to that cookie by page scripts
rationales: This is the central purpose of HttpOnly.
It is not a complete XSS defense.
Cross-site transmission also involves SameSite and CSRF controls.
The server still reads the cookie to handle sessions.
